say:1:1621513001:1.text: Excuse me, can I ask you something? If the Serene Lyceum were in danger, would you rise to protect it?
say:1:1621513001:1.source_cn: 羊阁下，如果莱希拉姆陷入混乱，你会挺身而出吗？

say:2:1621513002:1.text: What are you talking about? Are you trying to mess with me?!
say:2:1621513002:1.source_cn: 你是哪根筋搭错了吗！还是你找我寻开心？！

say:3:1621513003:1.text: Without realizing it, you have begun to grasp the animal language that once seemed so baffling and intricate.
say:3:1621513003:1.source_cn: 不知不觉间，原本模糊难懂的动物语言，如今在你耳中已变得...
say:3:1621513003:1.male: Without realizing it, you have begun to grasp the animal language that once seemed so baffling and intricate.
say:3:1621513003:1.female: Without realizing it, you have begun to grasp the animal language that once seemed so baffling and intricate.

say:4:1621513004:1.text: It's true that learning a language requires lots of listening and practice.
say:4:1621513004:1.source_cn: 学习语言就是需要多听多练——看来这句话不止对人适用，对...

say:5:1621513005:1.text: Just so you know, my owner's been especially nice to me today. I don't want anything to ruin my good mood.
say:5:1621513005:1.source_cn: 警告你，今天我的主人对我很好，我可不想糟蹋了好心情！

say:6:1621513006:1.text: Please hear me out. I'm not here to look for trouble.
say:6:1621513006:1.source_cn: 不……你听我说，我不是来找茬的。

say:7:1621513007:1.text: Look, Meowris is a devil, and she's secretly rallying animals for an uprising against humans.
say:7:1621513007:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝那个魔王，正在暗中联合各方动物，计划向人类发难。

say:8:1621513008:1.text: We're seeking allies to stand with us and put an end to her schemes!
say:8:1621513008:1.source_cn: 我们正在寻找志同道合的反抗者，一起阻止喵丽丝的计划！

say:9:1621513009:1.text: Why should I take your words seriously? You're just a mad dog.
say:9:1621513009:1.source_cn: 我可不信一个疯狗的胡话。

say:10:1621513010:1.text: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!
say:10:1621513010:1.source_cn: 我……我不是神经病！不信你问这位狼阁下！
say:10:1621513010:1.male: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!
say:10:1621513010:1.female: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!

choice_prompt:11:1621513010.text: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!
choice_prompt:11:1621513010.source_cn: 我……我不是神经病！不信你问这位狼阁下！
choice_prompt:11:1621513010.male: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!
choice_prompt:11:1621513010.female: I... I'm not mad! Ask this wolf if you don't believe me!

say:12:1621513011:1.text: ... Are you sure? There's pity in your voice.
say:12:1621513011:1.source_cn: ……你这语气听着都像在可怜他。
say:12:1621513011:1.male: ... Are you sure? There's pity in your voice.
say:12:1621513011:1.female: ... Are you sure? There's pity in your voice.

say:13:1621513012:1.text: Oh well, at least you seem normal compared to your buddy. Devil, he said? Come on, we're not living in a storybook world!
say:13:1621513012:1.source_cn: 但算了，至少你还算沉稳，不像这家伙一口一个魔王，不知道...
say:13:1621513012:1.male: Oh well, at least you seem normal compared to your buddy. Devil, he said? Come on, we're not living in a storybook world!
say:13:1621513012:1.female: Oh well, at least you seem normal compared to your buddy. Devil, he said? Come on, we're not living in a storybook world!

say:15:1621513016:1.text: Hey, what's all the racket for?! I want to comb my fur in peace! Go argue somewhere else!
say:15:1621513016:1.source_cn: 你们吵什么啊！害我一边耳朵的毛都捋歪了！要吵去那边！别...

say:16:1621513017:1.text: Hi there, we're assembling a force to oppose Meowris. Would you be interested...
say:16:1621513017:1.source_cn: 兔子阁下，我们正在集结反抗喵丽丝的力量——你要不要……

say:17:1621513018:1.text: Oppose Lady Meowris?! Are you insane?
say:17:1621513018:1.source_cn: 反抗喵丽丝大人？！你疯了吧？

say:19:1621513019:1.text: Hey, bunny, since when did you start calling the shots in this area? You're not even supposed to be grazing here!
say:19:1621513019:1.source_cn: 哟，你这吃越界草的兔子，什么时候这片草地成你家了，怎么...

say:20:1621513020:1.text: What's your beef, old sheep? This meadow is open to everyone!
say:20:1621513020:1.source_cn: 你这老羊张嘴就找茬是吧？！什么越界草，这片草地是谁都能...

say:21:1621513021:1.text: Nonsense! This meadow has belonged to sheep for generations, but you bunnies keep inching in. Don't push your luck!
say:21:1621513021:1.source_cn: 少废话！从我们祖祖辈辈开始，这块草场就是羊的领地。你们...

say:22:1621513022:1.text: Times have changed, old sheep! Now Lady Meowris decides everything!
say:22:1621513022:1.source_cn: 时代变了，老羊！现在是喵丽丝大人说了算！

say:23:1621513023:1.text: Meowris, my foot! This is sheep territory, so we're in charge! One more nibble of our young shoots, you're finished!
say:23:1621513023:1.source_cn: 喵什么喵！羊的地盘羊说了算！你要是再敢啃我们的嫩芽，我...

say:24:1621513024:1.text: How dare you oppose Lady Meowris and threaten me with violence! All of you are traitors!
say:24:1621513024:1.source_cn: 你们这群动物界的叛徒！在这谋反喵丽丝大人，还要对我大打出手！

say:25:1621513025:1.text: You'll pay for this! Mark my words!
say:25:1621513025:1.source_cn: 你们会付出代价的！给我等着！

say:26:1621513026:1.text: Hey... you said you're going against Meowris, right? Count me in! Ugh, I'm so mad I've lost my appetite!
say:26:1621513026:1.source_cn: 喂……刚才你说要推翻喵丽丝是吧？算我一个！我现在气得草...

say:28:1621513027:1.text: Awesome! We finally have someone new on the squad!

say:29:1621513028:1.text: All the credit is yours, my friend. Let's keep going and gather more allies!
say:29:1621513028:1.source_cn: 狼阁下，全靠你了，我们接着出发，去找更多愿意反抗的伙伴！
say:29:1621513028:1.male: All the credit is yours, my friend. Let's keep going and gather more allies!
say:29:1621513028:1.female: All the credit is yours, my friend. Let's keep going and gather more allies!

say:31:1621513013:1.text: Just adorable? What about his state of mind?
say:31:1621513013:1.source_cn: 哈，可爱？这么说算回答问题吗？
say:31:1621513013:1.male: Just adorable? What about his state of mind?
say:31:1621513013:1.female: Just adorable? What about his state of mind?

say:32:1621513014:1.text: By the way, watching him wag his tail cracks me up.
say:32:1621513014:1.source_cn: 不过他那副摇尾巴的样子，倒确实挺搞笑。
say:32:1621513014:1.male: By the way, watching him wag his tail cracks me up.
say:32:1621513014:1.female: By the way, watching him wag his tail cracks me up.

say:33:1621513015:1.text: I know, right? Everything he says is so cringe-worthy, my fur literally stands up.
say:33:1621513015:1.source_cn: 就说嘛，他一开口，我尴尬到脖子上的羊毛都开始打卷。
say:33:1621513015:1.male: I know, right? Everything he says is so cringe-worthy, my fur literally stands up.
say:33:1621513015:1.female: I know, right? Everything he says is so cringe-worthy, my fur literally stands up.

choice:11:2:3.text: He just likes playing the hero.
choice:11:2:3.male: He just likes playing the hero.
choice:11:2:3.female: He just likes playing the hero.
